description: Create a signed, tamper-evident receipt that THIS agent performed an action (e.g. sent an email, filed a form, made a payment). Call it right after you perform the action. Returns a SignedReceipt you can store or share; anyone can later verify it offline.

delegation_by.description: did:key or id of the principal who authorized this action, if any.

delegation_ref.description: Pointer to the grant (OAuth grant, AP2 mandate URL/URN).

outcome.description: Outcome of the action. Defaults to 'ok'.

params.description: The action's inputs. Stored only as a hash (privacy-preserving).

result.description: The observed result/response. Stored only as a hash.

summary.description: Human-readable one-line description of what was done.

type.description: Action verb in reverse-dot form, e.g. 'email.send', 'payment.send'.

name: attest_action
title: Attest an action
